message.content: A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) contains roughly **95 calories**. Smaller apples have fewer calories (≈ 77 kcal for a 149 g apple), while larger ones have more (≈ 116 kcal for a 223 g apple). The exact number varies slightly with variety and exact weight.

The user likely wants a general answer. According to typical nutrition facts, a medium apple (~182g) has about 95 calories. A small apple (~149g) has about 77 calories. A large apple (~223g) has about 116 calories. So we can provide a range or average. The user didn't specify a particular type or size.
